race.description: Tommy Berry 2025-2026 Hrc Champion Jockey Mdn Hcp
race.comment: ARTEMEX (1) returns a gelding after showing ability in his two preps. Chipped away late over this trip when fourth to Lord Horatio at Warwick Farm last May. Primed with the two sharp trials and the booking of Nash Rawiller is a good guide to his prospects. IGNITION CODE (6) three-year-old Stay Inside filly out of Isa Rocket on debut for the Waterhouse & Bott yard. Has shown enough in her two latest trials to play a leading role. BASCILICA BABE (10) comes here with a fitness edge third-up and looks to have solid each way claims. Snagged back from the wide draw before she savaged the line with a close-up fourth over this trip at Muswellbrook. Tempo suits and hard fit now. LAVA FLOW (4) started hard in the market on debut ($3.50 fav), when displaying good early speed before she faded to run seventh over 1200m at Canterbury. Finds an easier race from a good draw. Expected to run a much better race.
